description: Normative mapping from an accepted COMMAND frame (verb, noun, program, r1_centidegrees, r2_centidegrees, delta_v_tenths_fps) to the only canonical DSKY key sequence and postcondition permitted for it. Keys use agc_core.DskyKey member names. Consumed independently by mcp_server (planner + safety gate) and acoustic daemon (execution guard); both must produce identical plans.

SIGNED_5.description: PLUS when value >= 0, MINUS when value < 0, then abs(value) as exactly five zero-padded decimal digits. Values outside min..max are unrepresentable and the command is rejected (never clamped).

DIGITS_2.description: Exactly two decimal digits, tens first.

commands.summary: Load R1 azimuth (0.01 deg), R2 elevation (0.01 deg), R3 delta-v (0.1 ft/s) through V25 N81.
Load the burn tuple through V25 N81, then select P40 through V37. R1-R3 are visible while P40 is active (FR-11).
Select P00 (idle) through V37. Payload fields must be zero.
Terminate the current program; the subset returns to P00 and preserves R1-R3. Payload fields must be zero.

rules.description: COMMAND verb 37 while the inspected program is 40.
COMMAND verb 34 while the inspected program is 40.
Postcondition program is 40, inspected program is not 40, and abs(delta_v_tenths_fps) > p40_critical_delta_v_threshold_tenths_fps.
The accepted frame carries CRITICAL=1. The flag can only add criticality; it never removes a computed reason.

authorization.expiry_clock: Daemon received_at of the COMMAND; an AUTH is fresh only when AUTH.received_at < COMMAND.received_at + hold_expiry_ms. A HELD command is EXPIRED when now >= COMMAND.received_at + hold_expiry_ms.

preconditions.description: Required for every command at plan, gate, and daemon actuation time.

plan_digest.input: UTF-8 canonical JSON of {"catalog_version", "frame_seq", "keys"} with sorted object keys and separators (',', ':'); lowercase hex output.
